user_direction: All enemies modular; add minibosses and large boss types based on supplied enemy roster. This explicit request supersedes whole-plate restrictions for this art pack.
minibosses: FINAL EXPORT FRAME FORMAT:512x512 pixels per miniboss frame, pivot256,256, matched half-scale256x256 native export. Use case: stylized-concept. STYLE REFERENCES: first image is Mike's supplied Raiden enemy roster and is the principal authority; second is the current generated pack for consistent materials. Match the SPECIFIC dense hand-clustered 1990s arcade military pixel art, orthographic top-down camera, charcoal/black outlines, chamfered plates, tiny rivets and vents, desaturated olive/gunmetal, sharp steel glints, cyan instrument glass, tiny warm orange weapon ports. Original machines, no copies of an existing named game boss. No soft painted shading, vector art, gradients, generic mobile icons, cartoon toys, humans, organic monsters or mechs. Every vehicle faces SOUTH, toward bottom. No text, labels, numbers, frames, UI, ground, cast shadows, smoke, muzzle flashes, projectiles or terrain. Genuine transparent alpha, no magenta/checkerboard. Draw all mechanical parts fully contained; at least48px clear outer/cell margins. Exactly FOUR units in a spaced 2 by 2 layout, one per cell. Each machine is shown fully ASSEMBLED, with strongly visible mechanical seams separating a central chassis from independent cannons, missile racks, engines and propulsion assemblies; these will be exported as actual independent sprite layers. Each part must have complete legible architecture, contrasting dark joining seams, correct overhead view and physically clear mounting roots. No single silhouette with inseparable decorative painted weapons; use recognizably bolted-on modules. Keep all four units at one common proportional pixel scale. FRAME FORMAT: Deliver1536x1536 pixels, four identical768x768 source cells, same cell center pivot384,384, even padding and gutters, one proportional scale for the entire sheet. Create FOUR substantial MINIBOSS types, around twice a light enemy's mass, compact coherent hard military machines from the reference roster. Top-left: OLIVE ASSAULT TANK: broad tracked olive armored chassis, two clearly separate long silver south-facing cannon barrels mounted to separate turret housings on its upper hull, left/right complete tread assemblies, compact central command block. Top-right: QUAD BATTERY FORTRESS: square gunmetal/teal armored hover-platform, sturdy central reactor cover, exactly FOUR visibly independent corner cannon pods angled outward, each with its own small round armored base and barrel, thick mechanical vented body. Bottom-left: ORANGE HEAVY BOMBER: wide swept-wing silver-and-orange heavy attack aircraft with one coherent central fuselage, separate large left/right engine pods with rear nozzles, left/right south-facing forward cannon pods, and a small distinct closed center bomb-bay plate. Bottom-right: MISSILE CORVETTE: long olive and gray armored naval hull facing down, a clearly separate forward heavy cannon turret, two independent side missile-rack housings, two separate stern drive pods and a low bridge block. All designs entirely visible with plenty of separation and no cropping. Match the actual roster's practical tank/aircraft/bunker/boat silhouettes.
